inputs.text: [serious] It was a carnivore. [confident] It hunted the plant-eaters of Antarctica, in a great green forest.
[curious] A forest way down south, with plant-eaters?
[playful] Yep. [amazed] The forest fed plenty of plants, and so plenty of plant-eaters. [confident] Cryolophosaurus hunted them right there in all that green.
